fixes.fix: S.update sightline-clearing block (lines ~212-218): stop pushing peds that stand IN FRONT of the player. Drop the +2 m extension (use bx=bx0, bz=bz0), clamp t to [0, 0.85] so only peds between camera and player are moved, and skip peds within 4 m of the player inside a +-60 deg cone of player.yaw. Also exempt any ped whose state is 'idle'/'fight'/'stagger'. Today a standing target glides away at up to 3.7 m/s as you walk up (punch_approach: retreats 1.65 m, 0 hits).

updateOnFoot melee: findTarget range 2.9 -> 4.0 (5.0 while speed > 2), cone stays 1.15 rad. Lunge: C.lungeT 0.16 -> 0.26, distance up to min(d - 0.95, 2.2) m, speed cap 3.2 -> 7.0 m/s, and while C.lungeT > 0 set ch.speed = lunge speed (so the run cycle steps instead of both feet sliding 0.53 m at h = 0.10). If d > 2.2, insert an auto-advance: hold the punch until in range (C.next stays buffered for 0.5 s) while moving at PLAYER.run toward the target.

After line 234 add colliders for benchM: for each matrix push two circles r = 0.38 at +-0.55 m along the bench's long axis (or one poly 1.9 x 0.65 m OBB). Do the same for palms (r 0.3) and bollards. Player currently runs straight through benches (run_turns f015-f018) and knocked-down peds land inside them (punch f044); also run knocked-down peds through col.circleVsWorld(…, 0.35) in Character.update fall branch / peds.js state!=='ok' path.

Footstep trigger never fires (foot bone min height 0.078-0.097 m > 0.075 threshold; 0 triggers in all 10 scenarios). Track a rest height per foot (P.footRest = min over last 1 s, init from idle ~0.095) and fire when fy crosses down through footRest + 0.025, with a 0.18 s per-foot refractory. Jump landing: replace `else P.onGround = P.y - g.y < 0.05` with `else P.onGround = P.vy <= 0 && P.y - g.y < 0.05 && !wasAir` (or keep a separate P.air flag set at takeoff, cleared only on contact) so ch.landT = 0, the 0.7 speed scrub and onLand() actually fire (jump f37: onGround set one frame early, landing never detected).

Acceleration in updateOnFoot: acc = tgt > speed ? (speed < PLAYER.walk ? 2.6 : 4.2) -> (speed < PLAYER.walk ? 6.0 : 7.5), sprint ramp 5.0; decel to stop 6.5 -> 9.0 (run) with a 0.15 s ease-out tail. Targets: idle->jog 90% in ~0.4 s (now 0.93 s), sprint 90% in ~0.8 s (now 1.53 s). In the air (!P.onGround) clamp speed change to 1.5 m/s^2 and turnMax to 1.5 rad/s.

Yaw: replace the clamp step with a critically damped angular spring: P.yawRate += clamp((dy*14 - P.yawRate*2*sqrt(14))*dt, -28*dt, 28*dt); P.yaw += P.yawRate*dt with |yawRate| <= turnMax. Removes the 0 -> 5.3 rad/s one-frame onset seen in run_turns f39. Add a speed dip proportional to turn: tgt *= 1 - 0.22*clamp(|dy|/1.57,0,1) above 2 m/s, and raise lean roll clamp 0.14 -> 0.22 rad with gain 0.03.

Edge anticipation: before integrating, probe walkable() at 0.6/1.2 m ahead along P.yaw; if blocked, scale tgt by clamp(distToEdge/1.4, 0.15, 1) so the player decelerates into the quay edge instead of the 52 m/s^2 two-frame dead stop, and when pushing into the edge with speed < 0.3 set a 'teeter' flag that Character.upperBody turns into arms-out balance (reuse the airW arm pose at 0.5) and lean.pitch -0.08. Clamp ch.speed to 0 when blocked so idle plays instead of a 0.09 m/s shuffle. Optional: allow a deliberate dive when jump is pressed facing water within 0.8 m of the edge.

upperBody guard/punch: (a) guard target S + fwd*0.30 + UP*0.06 + right*(-sg*0.14) (fists at chin, not ears) with pole UP*-1 + right*sg*0.15 + fwd*0.1 so elbows tuck down instead of flaring; (b) add a lower-body combat stance when guardW > 0.3: rotate Bip01 (pelvis) 0.35 rad about UP toward the rear foot side, Thigh/Calf bend 0.18/-0.3 rad (knees soft), lead foot forward 0.15 m via a simple leg IK; (c) weight transfer on strike: translate this.body forward 0.06 m * atkE and drop 0.03 m; hook adds 0.12 rad hip yaw before the shoulder (hips lead by 2 frames). Right now punches are arms + spine only on an idle stance with parallel feet.

Stagger (state 'stagger', lines ~168-172): drive ch.speed = |knock|*k and set heading so the walk clip plays backwards-stepping (or set ch.act.walk.timeScale negative), or shorten the slide to 0.15 m and add a procedural 1-step pelvis drop; the victim currently skates 0.45 m at 2.2 m/s with ch.speed = 0. regressions: Start-up acceleration slightly slower than BEFORE: time to 90% run 0.87 -> 0.93 s, sprint 1.30 -> 1.53 s (already sluggish before).
With water now a hard wall, running into the quay edge produces a 52 m/s^2 two-frame dead stop with no anticipation or reaction animation (BEFORE it fell in the water instead).
New melee lunge introduces visible foot skating (0.53 m with both feet planted) that did not exist before because punches never moved the player.
improvements: Foot skating essentially fixed for straight-line gait: stance-foot slip 2.6-3.7 m/s (BEFORE, ~100% of body speed) -> 0.09-0.36 m/s (8-11%); sprint stance 0.16-0.6 m/s at 6.2 m/s.
Speeds now match clip cadence (walk 1.24 vs clip 1.21; BEFORE 2.88 m/s for a gentle push), and the analog curve gives walk / jog / run by stick deflection.
Water: no scenario ends swimming (BEFORE shore and sprint_stop both ended in the river).
Standing punches connect: 3/3 hits with lock-on turn, jab-cross-hook combo, hit-stop, shake and knockdown (BEFORE 0 hits).
Victims fight back (guard + counter-punches) and crimes raise wanted stars with police arriving.
HUD: minimap no longer covers the player (BEFORE it hid her in every punch frame); player framed slightly left of centre.
Capture is stable: all 10 scenarios incl. phone completed with no page errors (BEFORE the harness crashed with the browser closed).
verdict: FAIL (overall 5.99, four dimensions below 6). Big step from BEFORE: gait is now real mocap with planted feet, the river edge is solid and standing punches land. But it still does not feel like Rockstar: the hero takes ~1 s to reach a jog and steers freely in the air, turns snap on, every lunge and stagger is a skate, the guard reads as hands-over-ears on an idle stance, the knockdown is a rigid plank that clips into benches and the get-up levitates. Worst for the user's 'punches don't work' complaint: in normal play a ped you walk toward gets shoved away by the camera sightline code and the 2.9 m lock-on range plus 0.5 m lunge can't close the gap, so the approach scenario lands 0/3. Footsteps and landing cues are silent because of two threshold bugs, and benches have no collision. Fix the P1 list (sightline exemption, lock-on/lunge with stepping, bench colliders, footstep/landing bugs, faster acceleration) before polishing poses.
